messages:
Maya G.: heads-up: saw thermal throttle causing p95 spikes last night, thinking we should soft-degrade instead of hard-evict.
Alex R.: which pool? logs?
Maya G.: dedicated-gpu-prod-us-west-2, ~02:12 UTC. snippet: `thermal_event=true clocks:1100->600 p95:620ms->1.8s`.
Samir: evicting on throttle is noisy. propose burst-lane + soft-eviction credits for low-priority tenants.
Jin: need concrete control knobs and routing implications; worried about KV cache churn.
Maya G.: v1: when node reports thermal -> pool.soft_degrade=true; open token-bucket burst lane; progressive qps caps by priority; soft-eviction credits decay over 10m.
Alex R.: include a per-cluster kill-switch and per-tenant opt-out. rollout: staging pool -> 10% canary in prod behind feature flag `thermal_soft_degrade_v1`. alert if canary p95 for high-priority tenants increases >10%.
Samir: metrics to add: gpu_temp_histogram, throttle_events, p95_by_priority, tokens_burned_by_tenant, soft_degrade_shed_rate.
Jin: operator will expose flag and per-tenant override API; add dashboard panels for token-bucket drain and kvcache-hit after degrade.
Maya G.: config stub to include: mode, burst token settings, qps caps, soft credit ttl, hard-evict cost budget. will draft RFC with YAML and rollout steps.
OpsBot: feature-flag thermal_soft_degrade_v1 enabled in staging at 2026-03-22T10:15:00Z :white_check_mark:
